## Checklist

- [ ] The PR does one thing, and its title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat(editor): …`).
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` pass locally.
- [ ] New behavior has tests; a bug fix has a test that failed before the fix.
- [ ] UI works in light and dark themes, at phone width, and with the keyboard alone.
- [ ] User-facing strings go through `t()`.
- [ ] Docs are updated if behavior changed.
